explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/209 with the negative answer (Füredi–Palásti for 9 ∤ d; Escudero for all d ≥ 4). It is not true that every arrangement of d ≥ 4 pairwise non-parallel lines with no point on four or more lines has a Gallai triangle: three lines meeting pairwise at three distinct points, each lying on exactly two lines of A. Since Escudero works projectively, the linked formal proof is what supports the affine statement.
